evidence: Has the 'Block storage' label and modifies block storage directory locking within BlockManager (`src/node/blockstorage`).
rationale: Locks the blocks directory directly in BlockManager to prevent silent data corruption by kernel consumers. As documented in the PR description, non-bitcoind consumers like standalone kernel binaries currently omit directory locks and would silently open blk00000.dat in 'rb+' mode, overwriting blocks from offset 0 while a live node continues running and serving corrupted data.
